items.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is Becoming Store of Value
points: Tom Lee predicts Ethereum is transitioning from purely transactional asset to store of value, comparable to digital gold, which could reshape its valuation framework.

items.title: Solana Acquires CoinGecko for Distribution and DeFi Integration
points: Solana Foundation secured majority stake in CoinGecko, a crypto price/data platform founded in Malaysia in 2014 serving tens of millions of monthly users and 180,000 developers

Post-acquisition roadmap includes integrating Solana-native trading and DeFi (decentralized finance, meaning financial services running on blockchain without traditional intermediaries) experiences directly into CoinGecko's platform
Planned expansion beyond crypto to equities and real-world assets positions CoinGecko as a multi-asset data layer
Deal gives Solana direct distribution access to CoinGecko's 180,000 developer and API base, establishing the chain as the primary execution layer for DeFi trading on the platform

items.title: Coinbase ChatGPT Plugin Enters Agentic Trading Market
points: Users can connect Coinbase accounts to trade stocks, crypto, and derivatives without leaving ChatGPT, with approval required for each transaction to maintain user control
First financial transaction-enabled app in ChatGPT's plugin store, marking early mainstream integration of agentic (autonomous AI-driven) trading into conversational interfaces
Execution remains within chat conversation flow, reducing friction compared to switching between applications
Plugin enables text-to-trade workflows but preserves user authority over order execution, addressing custody and permission concerns

items.title: Agentic Trading Stack Layers and Value Distribution
points: Stack divides into four layers: Intelligence (data and market reasoning models), Agency (harnesses, terminals, copilots—the frameworks that run agents), Execution (venue connectivity), and Compliance (trust infrastructure for autonomous decisions)
OpenClaw accumulated ~250K GitHub stars in 60 days; trading-specialized harnesses like Senpi and Supertake compete across stocks, options, and prediction markets with cross-asset terminals

Agent capability itself carries no defensible moat since open-source models commoditize agent capability; value concentrates with whoever owns the decision loop (Intent-as-a-Service), platforms with deepest liquidity, and custodians trusted across broadest asset classes

Coinbase Ventures investing across three pillars: Agency layer (harnesses and terminals), proprietary Intelligence (specialized market reasoning models), and Compliance (agent identity and tamper-proof decision logs)
On-chain derivatives now split 58% crypto and 42% real-world assets (RWA, meaning physical assets like commodities or real estate tokenized on blockchain), signaling major market shift

items.title: Street Launches Board-Aligned Private Equity Secondary Marketplace
points: Street emerged from stealth with $200M in open interest on day one, targeting compliance gaps where 5 of 6 major secondary platforms closed transactions without board knowledge
CEO cited OpenAI and Anthropic public disclosures that billions in secondary sales were illicit and voided, establishing compliance as founding differentiator
Partnered with Google and capital allocators to deliver brokerage-style experience instead of traditional secondary marketplace model

Long-term goal to become American Exchange for Private Equity, competing with SPV-based structures (special purpose vehicles, temporary legal entities created for single transactions) that dominate private secondary markets
